newsitem.title: USA: United Meridian, Mobil find tests 6,155 BPD.
newsitem.headline: United Meridian, Mobil find tests 6,155 BPD.

text.p: United Meridian Corp said Friday that it and its partner, Mobil Equatorial Guinea Inc, a unit of Mobil Corp, completed the QI-100-CH well, or Serpentina 1, a new, separate field discovery, which tested 6,155 barrels of oil per day from two intervals.
The Serpentina 1 is located about 2.5 miles northeast of the Jade 1 discovery well and about five miles northeast of the main Zafiro/Opalo field complex, United Meridian said.

The Jade field discovery was made in December 1996 by the IQI-105-1 well, or Jade 1, which was drilled to a total depth of 6,272 feet and flowed 2,000 barrels of oil per day from restricted rate tests in two zones within the Qua Iboe formation, United Meridian said.
United Meridian said it holds a 25-percent interest in Block B. Mobil Equatorial Guinea is the operator with the remaining 75 percent, United Meridian said.
